Constraints: no_lookahead: true; only_registry_indicators: true

Stochastic crossovers capture short‑term momentum reversals while RSI oversold/overbought levels confirm the strength of the move; ATR provides a volatility‑based filter and risk sizing, together generating more frequent but still high‑quality trades.

Combining oversold/overbought conditions from RSI and Stochastic with a volatility filter based on ATR ensures entries only when the market has sufficient movement, reducing false signals and improving trade frequency.
